title: AdvancedRPC
tag_line: Customizable Discord Rich Presence for Career, BeamMP and Split Screen.
message: Version 1.1.0: BeamNG 0.40 support, Split Screen player selection, English/Russian settings, ready presets, image URL checks and demand-driven telemetry. Settings: Esc > Mods > AdvancedRPC. Optional Windows startup for AdvancedRPC Bridge. made by wolary (w0kx)
